name: leaderboard-table
title: Leaderboard Table
description: Score bars with +/-std whiskers plus numeric economy columns (cost/tokens/steps), one row per model run, with version and Best/All-effort-levels toggles, model filter, and rank-morphing rows.

meta.question: Who leads on score, with what confidence spread, and what does that score cost?
meta.whenToUse: Benchmark leaderboards where score alone is not enough: each run carries a spread (std) and economy metrics, and models have multiple effort levels worth comparing.
meta.antiUse: Wide-figure genre (min-width ~700px) — not for narrow containers or mobile cards; for a single metric without spread or economy columns, rank-bars is lighter.
